capabilities: Search and read vault notes with find, grep and read tools
Answer with cited line links into the notes it read
Approve or reject each note change on a card
Rewind a conversation and revert the notes it changed
Run shell commands, fetch URLs and call MCP tools
disambiguation: Not a file organizer or note-cataloguing tool; it is a chat agent that reads and edits notes on request.
extras: Needs a model endpoint that supports tool calling; API keys are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage and can be sealed into data.json with a sync passphrase. Read-only tools run without asking on a new install, and the README notes that vault enumeration may be reported on the community scorecard. No telemetry.
problem: Answering questions that span many notes, or letting an AI edit notes, otherwise means manual searching or trusting an assistant with no review step.

relations.evidence: the same compatibility flags as Pi's models.json
the same format Google Calendar Tasks Sync uses
from Ollama for models it serves (also behind Open WebUI)

summary: Chat agent that searches and reads vault notes with tools, answers with cited lines, and applies note changes only after approval.
